psychological_meaning: Lily represents purity, innocence, and tranquility. It evokes a sense of calm and sophistication, often associated with grace and elegance. Lily can also symbolize new beginnings and hope, making it a versatile choice for designs aiming to create a peaceful and refined atmosphere.

real_world_examples.title: Lily Bouquet
real_world_examples.description: A beautiful bouquet of lilies symbolizes purity and love, often used in weddings and celebrations.

real_world_examples.title: Lily Pond
real_world_examples.description: A serene lily pond reflects tranquility and peace, often found in gardens and parks.
